Dinosaur.Canvas: Dinosaur game. Space or up arrow to jump; down arrow to duck.
Dinosaur.ConnectionFailed: WebSocket connection failed. Check the URL, running server, token and browser console.
Dinosaur.InvalidAddress: Enter the full ws:// or wss:// server URL, including /ws/node-id; do not include a token in the URL.
Dinosaur.InvalidPulse: Check channel, strength (0–100%), frequency (1–100 Hz), and duration (200–2000 ms).
Dinosaur.Keys: Space / ↑ jump · ↓ hold to duck · P pause / resume · Esc pause and stop output
Dinosaur.NoDevices: No compatible output devices are exported by this server.
Dinosaur.OutputHelp: One pulse per collision; jumping sends no output. The server also limits strength. Switching away pauses the game and disables output. Re-enable it manually. Only the best score is saved.
Dinosaur.OutputOff: Output disabled. The game can run without a device.
Dinosaur.PulseSent: Collision pulse accepted by the server.
Dinosaur.RequestTimeout: The server did not respond in time. Disconnected; output must be enabled again manually.
Dinosaur.StartHint: Space / ↑ or tap to jump. Hold ↓ to duck.
Dinosaur.Title: Dinosaur
Dinosaur.ZeroStrength: Strength is 0; no pulse was sent.
Error.DeviceInUse: A target device is already controlled by another running mode.
Error.ModeDeviceMismatch: This mode is incompatible with an assigned device. Pumps require pump mode; motion modes require a motion-capable device.
Error.RemoteAuthentication: Authentication failed. Check the server token.
Error.RemoteExpired: The command deadline has expired or is invalid.
Error.RemoteLease: The device lease is invalid, expired, or belongs to another connection.
Error.RemoteLeaseType: The method does not match the lease type.
Error.RemoteLocalDevices: Select connected, supported local Bluetooth devices for export.
Error.RemoteMethod: This remote method is not supported.
Error.RemoteSequence: Request IDs and lease sequences must increase without reuse.
Error.RemoteSettings: Check the WebSocket address, port, lease time, and output limit.
Error.RemoteVersion: The server protocol version is not supported.
Error.StopUnconfirmed: Some devices did not confirm that output stopped.
